basis: NN established the threshold crossing by March 10, 2022. Its consolidated GAAP net sales for the three months ended December 31, 2021 were $110,379,000 versus $119,028,000 a year earlier, with Life Sciences treated as discontinued operations. Sales fell 7.27% and were $2,697,600 below the $113,076,600 cutoff. The earliest date remains unresolved because NN announced a public presentation for September 14, 2021 whose contents could not be verified. The upper bound below records the verified quarterly actual.

coverage.detail: The August 5 release reported $123.2 million of Q2 sales and gave no numeric Q4 consolidated sales ceiling.
Q2 slide 16 expected second-half sales to be consistent with the first half after an unquantified adjustment for normal Q4 seasonality. That wording leaves the Q4 high end open.

Following NN’s Q2 event link reached the host, which confirms August 6 at 9 a.m. EDT and marks the replay expired. The secondary transcript at https://www.roic.ai/quote/NNBR/transcripts/2021-year/2-quarter records continued suspension of formal guidance. The shift-day discussion supplies no Q4 sales ceiling.

A newly located issuer deck identifies itself on the cover as the August 2021 KeyBanc roadshow. Its $600 million sales objective is for 2025. Its cover and forecast period rule it out as verification of the September Lake Street presentation.

NN’s September 1 notice scheduled its presentation for public posting before the September 14 market open, alongside invitation-only one-on-one meetings. The notice gives no quarterly sales figure or direct deck link.

The historical host URL and https://web.archive.org/web/20210914000000/https://www.lakestreetcapitalmarkets.com/big5conference were inaccessible. The readable host roster at https://www.lakestreetcapitalmarkets.com/presenting-companies is dated September 10, 2026.

The issuer index returned 2026 presentations. The historical lookup at https://web.archive.org/web/20210915000000/https://investors.nninc.com/news-events/presentations and the filter at https://investors.nninc.com/news-events/presentations?field_nir_event_date_value=2021 were inaccessible. Another issuer PDF at https://investors.nninc.com/static-files/bc8bff69-0969-4e25-b421-9f092ad3e067 identifies a September 13 Lake Street event and includes the former Life Sciences business.

The September 16 listing credits NN with publishing the event deck. The readable page exposes no slide contents. The article endpoint at https://seekingalpha.com/api/v3/articles/4455672 was inaccessible.

The supplied 8-K inventory lists no September exhibit. The date-filtered SEC search and https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000918541.json were inaccessible. The exhibit searches yielded no readable September deck.
The November 4 release reported $117.2 million of Q3 sales, up 3.1%. Its discussion of semiconductor shortages gave no Q4 consolidated revenue range.
Q3 slides 13–15 described soft Q4 Mobile Solutions demand and approximately 3% year-over-year Q4 demand growth for Power Solutions. Neither segment outlook establishes a consolidated sales ceiling.

NN’s Q3 event link reached the host, which confirms November 5 at 9 a.m. EDT and marks the replay expired. The secondary transcript at https://www.roic.ai/quote/NNBR%3AUS/transcripts/2021-year/3-quarter records that formal revenue guidance remained suspended. The 17.8% decline was IHS’s forecast for global vehicle production, to 19.4 million units.

This alternate archive lists audio for both calls. Its linked pages at https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nnbr/transcripts/423192-q2-2021/ and https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nnbr/transcripts/10405-q3-2021/ returned cache misses.
The release text is datelined December 16, 2021 and announces a January 10, 2022 appointment. It gives no quarterly sales estimate.

The February 24 announcement concerned a Power Solutions plant closure. The same day’s earnings notice at https://www.nninc.com/nn-inc-to-hold-fourth-quarter-2021-earnings-conference-call-on-friday-march-11-2022/ scheduled results for March 10 after market close. Neither supplied preliminary Q4 sales.
The March 4 exhibit amended leverage covenants for 2022 and 2023. It gave no Q4 2021 sales estimate.

The reopened IR release and SEC Exhibit 99.1 both show 110,379 and 119,028 in thousands of dollars in the three-month net-sales row. The consolidated reconciliation independently labels those amounts GAAP net sales.

publication_date_evidence: NN’s IR release is timestamped March 10, 2022 at 4:30 p.m. EST, and Exhibit 99.1 carries the March 10 dateline. That establishes when NN published actuals. The September 1 posting notice and September 16 slideshow listing do not establish what quarterly figures, if any, appeared in the September presentation.
